messages:
Priya: Quick micro-sync: proposing marketplace cutover next Wed. Landing 09:00 PT, press 09:05, blog 09:15, partner emails 09:30. Objections?
Liam: thumbs up. prefer press at :05 to honor embargo. ops can we delay big ingest by +10m?
Noah: yes. core tenant provisioning must be ready by 09:00. will throttle non-critical ingest until 09:10.
Ava: marketing can publish at 09:05. need 5m heads-up before cutover to queue socials. @Priya can you send?
Priya: will send 5m ping. Marta, confirm ApexEdge hero size and dark-mode asset?
Marta: confirmed 1200x400 hero + dark-mode PNG. uploading to /assets/partners/apexedge. listing id mkp-APX-2025.
Priya: SI partners IntegralSI & AtlasWorks need pre-warm access. @Noah can you provision?
Noah: service accounts created; smoke endpoints ready by 08:20 PT. KV warm sweep at 08:30 PT.
Liam: press copy: no customer names until legal clears. legal pinged; fallback to product quote.
Ava: blog plan: short lead + 3 partner callouts + technical sidebar. final draft by EOD please.
Noah: ops note: set temporary throughput cap first 30m to avoid spikes. recommending 120% baseline.
Marta: hardware team on standby at 09:00 to swap hero if needed. partner telemetry posts to partner portal webhook (endpoint live).
Priya: deploy-bot create temp channel topic and pin runbook at cutover.
deploy-bot: Done. Runbook pinned: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-launch-microtiming
calendar-bot: Reminder set: "Marketplace launch preflight" 08:00 PT Wed.
Priya: adding 3 canned CS responses for pricing, onboarding timeline, data residency. Ava to add to runbook?
Ava: adding now.
Priya: Final checklist:
- 08:00 PT preflight (all teams) - confirm smoke
- 08:20 PT SI endpoints ready
- 08:30 PT KV warm sweep
- 09:00 PT landing cutover
- 09:05 PT press release publish
- 09:10 PT social go (5m after press)
- 09:15 PT blog publish
- 09:30 PT partner outbound email
Priya: please react :thumbsup: if aligned or flag blockers now.
Liam: :thumbsup:
Noah: :thumbsup:
Ava: :thumbsup:
Marta: :thumbsup:
Priya: thanks — I'll post minute-by-minute runbook 1h before launch.
